items.title: Sempra (SRE) Raises Oncor Five Year Capital Plan 20%
items.summary: Sempra (NYSE:SRE) said Oncor's five-year capital plan will be 20% larger, citing strong electricity demand growth in Texas. The utility owner linked the higher Oncor spending outlook to infrastructure needs tied to ongoing economic and population expansion in the state. Sempra also outlined plans to sell a 45% equity stake in Sempra Infrastructure Partners to KKR as part of a portfolio reshaping.
